MUTUAL FREELANCE NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is made between Apex Tech Inc. ("Company") and John Smith ("Contractor").

SECTION 1. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
Confidential Information includes all proprietary source code, software architecture, client lists, and trade secrets disclosed by either party.

SECTION 2. TERM & DURATION (PREAMBLE)
This Agreement and the confidentiality obligations herein shall remain in full force and effect for a period of two (2) years following the date of disclosure.

SECTION 3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY & NON-COMPETE
Contractor agrees not to engage in any freelance development or employment with any company operating in the software sector worldwide for a period of 5 years.

SECTION 4. ARBITRATION
All controversies or disputes shall be submitted to mandatory binding arbitration, and the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover reasonable attorney fees.

SECTION 5. PERPETUAL CONFIDENTIALITY (SECTION 5)
Notwithstanding any other provision in this Agreement, Contractor's obligation to maintain strict confidentiality of all disclosed materials shall survive indefinitely and continue in perpetuity.
